images.title: 729 splits into three equal groups
images.purpose: Shows the six prime factors 3 of 729 split into three identical groups of 3 × 3, so 729 = 9 × 9 × 9.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. The number at the top, three identical groups of tiles in a row in the middle, and one equation below.
images.exact_structure: At the top centre: 729 in large dark digits. Below it, three groups side by side with clear gaps, each group a pair of round tiles reading 3 and 3, six tiles in all. Group 1 is filled teal (#0072B2), group 2 amber (#E69F00), group 3 reddish purple (#CC79A7). Below the groups, centred: 9 × 9 × 9. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: A number is a perfect cube when its prime factors split into three identical groups; one group is the cube root.
